strengths: Locals would recognize the mixed-room street: kei truck waiting, parked bikes pushing walkers into the middle, neighborhood anger at highway speed
School-route paint, volunteers, and 'not automatically charming' match everyday complaint culture without invented first-person memoir
Seasonal geometry (snow, hedges) is a local taken-for-granted that tourism copy usually skips

issues.location: ## How Japanese People Walk These Roads — genkan
issues.problem: Japanese people do not generally explain missing curbs through the genkan. The inside/outside shoe boundary is real, but it is a stretch as a reason the sidewalk was never built.
issues.suggestion: Do not treat genkan as causal. If kept, frame it only as how 'outside' feels, not as sidewalk philosophy.

issues.location: body-rules opening of the local section
issues.problem: 'Children learn a set of body rules' is directionally true (traffic-safety education) but slightly postcard-universal.
issues.suggestion: Soften to what many school routes teach, without implying every household recites the same code.
